name: PickerResult
description: Represents a resolved or selected item of data.
example:
Dim objPickerDialog As PickerDialog
Dim objPickerProperties As PickerProperties
Dim objPickerProperty As PickerProperty
Dim objPickerExistingResults As PickerResults
Dim objPickerExistingResult As PickerResult
Dim objPickerResults As PickerResults


' Configure the Picker Dialog properties.
Set objPickerDialog = Application.PickerDialog
objPickerDialog.DataHandlerId = "{000CDF0A-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}"
objPickerDialog.Title = "Sample Picker Dialog"
Set objPickerProperties = objPickerDialog.Properties
Set objPickerProperty = objPickerProperties.Add("SiteUrl", "https://my", msoPickerFieldtypeText)
Set objPickerExistingResults = objPickerDialog.CreatePickerResults
Set objPickerExistingResult = objPickerExistingResults.Add("johndoe@contoso.com", "John Doe", "User")

' Show the Picker Dialog and get the results.
Set objPickerResults = objPickerDialog.Show(True, objPickerExistingResult)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the PickerResult object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the PickerResult object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Retrieves the unique Id of the associated PickerResult object. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Represents a display name of PickerResult. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of a PickerResult object. Read/write.

properties.name: SIPId
properties.description: The identifier for Office Communication Server, used only for the people picking scenario. Read/write.

properties.name: ItemData
properties.description: Gets or sets a non-display purpose item binding to data. Read/write.

properties.name: SubItems
properties.description: Display purpose or non-display purpose field data of a PickerResult object, used for passing column values in a PickerDialog. Read/write.

properties.name: DuplicateResults
properties.description: Gets PickerResult collection if the result of resolving results has multiple candidates. Read-only.

properties.name: Fields
properties.description: Represents field definitions of SubItems in a PickerFields collection. Read-only.
